title: Staging build cannot find amplify_outputs.json: papyrus resolves PAPYRUS_ROOT inside the venv, not the checkout
description: CMS staging job 1 (app dv0pdx67fk80m, branch staging) failed at `papyrus ops content export-published --drafts` with "Missing amplify_outputs.json". The cutover note blamed a missing backend association; the build log shows that message ("No backend environment association found, continuing") is benign, and that `npx ampx generate outputs --branch main --app-id $AWS_APP_ID` DID write amplify_outputs.json into the checkout. Root cause: a pip-installed papyrus resolves PAPYRUS_ROOT (src/papyrus_content/env.py) to a directory inside the venv, so it never looks at the checkout. Fix: run the two staging papyrus commands with PAPYRUS_ROOT="$PWD" in the template cms-staging build spec (infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.ts), plus synth test. Staging keeps sharing main backend.

Fix: Papyrus PR #148 (merged 18ce3c4) runs the two staging papyrus commands with PAPYRUS_ROOT="$PWD". Next: release, Pilobol.us pin bump, stack update, staging job.

comments.text: Fixed in two Papyrus PRs: #148 (PAPYRUS_ROOT="$PWD" for staging papyrus commands) and #152 (staging build copies amplify_outputs.json into .next and sets PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_OUTPUTS; no backend association means Amplify omits it from the SSR bundle, gate returned 500). Live stack updated; staging job 4 SUCCEED; anonymous staging.pilobol.us/ and an article path redirect 307 to /newsroom; newsroom and apex unchanged.
